title: Explorer card
responsibility: Draws one explorer card as an article, or as a labelled section, around the content it is given.

inputs.name: Card.as
inputs.description: Semantic container: article by default, section for a region, or li inside a resource list.

inputs.name: Card.variant
inputs.description: Visual treatment: card by default, or module to retain specialized catalog styling without an extra card frame.

inputs.name: Card.tone
inputs.description: Owner styling classes appended to the selected treatment. Defaults to an empty string.

inputs.name: Card.id
inputs.description: Optional native id. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting the attribute.

inputs.name: Card.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting aria-label.

inputs.name: Card.labelledby
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting aria-labelledby. Supply the heading id when the card should be named.

inputs.name: Card.component
inputs.description: Optional owning component id suffix for evidence attribution. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting data-harness-component.

outputs.name: Card
outputs.description: An article or section with the shared ex-card style.

errors.name: Child snippet error
errors.description: Errors thrown while rendering the required children snippet propagate to the caller.
